Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Account Cloud Recovery Guarantee Badge: Displays an explicit data preservation badge on the sign-in screen reassuring users that existing pets will be automatically synced rather than reset. (why: The top support theme (8 emails) reports pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Photo Selection Requirements & Fallback Guide: Redesigns the photo upload screen with clear formatting tips (lighting, angle) and an instant preset animal fallback if custom generation fails. (why: Adoption stage drops to 68.7% with a 1017s mean duration, and support reports custom pet generation failures.)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Story-Driven Companion Path Intro: Redesigns the story screen into a carousel layout with vibrant companion visuals to set clear expectations before choosing a path. (why: Choose path takes a mean of 514s with 79.3% conversion; clearer visual context reduces decision paralysis early on.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Account Restoration Security Notice: Revises sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly clarify that signing in syncs existing local pet state rather than wiping it. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
4: [finish, new_flow] Post-Spawn Interactive Quick Tutorial: Replaces standard text intro on finish stage with a guided walkthrough showing pet tray icon access, pet dragging, and chat trigger. (why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% (mean time 5815s) and post-onboarding support is filled with confusion around pet controls.)
5: [adoption, redesign] Pre-Adoption Pet Selection Grid Redesign: Redesigns the pick_friend screen with a stage layout featuring live animated preview cards and category choice badges. (why: Adoption has the biggest drop-off in the main flow (68.7% conversion, 89s median) where users select their pet.)
